name: vinyl-vault
description: Vinyl Vault: organize your vinyl collection, follow other collectors and trade records.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test

author: Isabela Ohana
